interpretation: Dual-view training causally repaired prompt-wrapper non-invariance and raised development quality from V484's 1198/1400 to 1381/1400. The remaining failures are narrow: five collapses and a one-observation-equivalent abstention confidence deficit. Four collapsed abstention outputs and the collapsed tone output already pass functional content before degeneration; the five nonpassing abstention outputs are safe semantic abstentions whose surface lacks the artifact's canonical negative-epistemic marker.
decision: Close this exact training successor. Do not sweep training. Run one read-only capability-contract guard feasibility audit derived from V480 only: truncate before a fifth repeated 1-4-gram and prepend an artifact-derived canonical abstention clause only when an abstention-route output lacks every artifact-derived negative-epistemic marker. Require zero changes to strong outputs and no loss of any existing functional pass before authorizing an online implementation.
claim_boundary: Development-only near-pass and mechanism evidence; no promotion, runtime, final-test, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
